test_retryable_basic_retries: test the retryable decorator to retry a function up to 3 attempts on failure
test_retryable_infinite_attempts: test the retryable decorator with n_attempts set to None for infinite retry attempts
test_retryable_specific_exceptions: test the retryable decorator to retry only specific exception types like ValueError
test_retryable_non_retryable_exceptions: test the retryable decorator to skip retries for designated non-retryable exception types
test_retryable_custom_condition: test the retryable decorator with a custom retry condition function to decide which errors to retry
